newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev closes flat vs dollar and mark.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev closes flat vs dollar and mark.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed around 994.50-995.30 per mark, in a narrower spread than the opening 994-995.50, after thin and quiet interbank trade, dealers said.
* There was larger foreign currency supply from banks and clients after the introduction of a currency board system and the central bank was seen as a main mark bidder at 995 levs.
* The lev was pegged at 1,000 per mark as anchor currency under an IMF-prescribed fixed exchange rate mechanism, know as currency board, launched last Tuesday.
* Under the currency board system the Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) pledged to buy and sell unlimited volumes of marks, the anchor currency, at a bid of 995 levs and an ask of 1,000.
* The BNB Issue Department said on Monday it boosted its assets and liabilities to three billion marks from 2.8 billion marks a week ago when the currency board system was launched.
* The lev closed at 1,742-1,744 per dollar unchanged from the opening as traders adjusted rates to the lev/mark levels and mark/dollar cross on global markets.
